146-a-little-princess-being-the-whole-st.title: A Little Princess
146-a-little-princess-being-the-whole-st.creator: Frances Hodgson Burnett
146-a-little-princess-being-the-whole-st.description: A book by Frances Hodgson Burnett. At this moment she was remembering the voyage she had just made from Bombay with her father, Captain Crewe. She was thinking of the big ship, of the Lascars passing silently to and fro on it, of the children playing about on the hot deck, and of some young officers' wives who used to try to make her talk to them and laugh at the things she said.

arxiv-2101-04035.title: Machine Learning Uncertainty as a Design Material: A Post-Phenomenological Inquiry CCS: Human-centered computing HCI theory, concepts and models Conference: CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 8–13, 2021; Yokohama, Japan CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI
arxiv-2101-04035.creator: Jesse Josua Benjamin, Arne Berger, Nick Merrill, James Pierce
arxiv-2101-04035.description: Abstract . Design research is important for understanding and interrogating how emerging technologies shape human experience. However, design research with Machine Learning (ML) is relatively underdeveloped. Crucially, designers have not found a grasp on ML uncertainty as a design opportunity rather than an obstacle. The technical literature points to data and model uncertainties as two main properties of ML.

arxiv-2202-02961.title: Efficient ADMM Decoder for Non-binary LDPC Codes with Codeword-Independent Performance
arxiv-2202-02961.creator: Xiaomeng Guo, Yongchao Wang
arxiv-2202-02961.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiaomeng Guo, Yongchao Wang. In this paper, we devote to devise a non-binary low-density parity-check (LDPC) decoder in Galois fields of characteristic two ( 𝔽 2 q \mathbb{F}_{2^{q}} ) via the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) technique. Through the proposed bit embedding technique and the decomposition technique of the three-variables parity-check equation, an efficient ADMM decoding algorithm for non-binary LDPC codes is proposed.

arxiv-2206-10254.title: Towards Optimizing OCR for Accessibility
arxiv-2206-10254.creator: Peya Mowar Tanuja Ganu Saikat Guha
arxiv-2206-10254.description: Abstract Visual cues such as structure, emphasis, and icons play an important role in efficient information foraging by sighted individuals and make for a pleasurable reading experience. Blind, low-vision and other print-disabled individuals miss out on these cues since current OCR and text-to-speech software ignore them, resulting in a tedious reading experience.

arxiv-2408-02110.title: AvatarPose: Avatar-guided 3D Pose Estimation of Close Human Interaction from Sparse Multi-view Videos
arxiv-2408-02110.creator: Feichi Lu ∗, Zijian Dong ∗, Jie Song †, Otmar Hilliges
arxiv-2408-02110.description: Abstract Despite progress in human motion capture, existing multi-view methods often face challenges in estimating the 3D pose and shape of multiple closely interacting people. This difficulty arises from reliance on accurate 2D joint estimations, which are hard to obtain due to occlusions and body contact when people are in close interaction.

arxiv-2412-14927.title: Ghost Josephson plasmon in bilayer superconductors
arxiv-2412-14927.creator: Niccolò Sellati, Lara Benfatto
arxiv-2412-14927.description: Abstract The experimental measurement of collective charge fluctuations in metals and superconductors is a preferential tool to benchmark fundamental interactions in solids. Recent experiments in multicomponent systems, from superconducting layered cuprates to multiband metals, highlighted striking effects due to the interplay between different degrees of freedom.

arxiv-2508-04287.title: Parameter Estimation for Weakly Interacting Hypoelliptic Diffusions
arxiv-2508-04287.creator: Yuga Iguchi, Alexandros Beskos, Grigorios A. Pavliotis
arxiv-2508-04287.description: Abstract We study parameter estimation for interacting particle systems (IPSs) consisting of N \displaystyle N weakly interacting multivariate hypoelliptic SDEs. We propose a locally Gaussian approximation of the transition dynamics, carefully designed to address the degenerate structure of the noise (diffusion matrix), thus leading to the formation of a well-defined full likelihood.

arxiv-2512-09256.title: Observation of ubiquitous charge correlations and hidden quantum critical point in hole-doped kagome superconductors
arxiv-2512-09256.creator: Ilija K. Nikolov, Giuseppe Allodi, Adrien Rosuel, Ginevra Corsale, Anshu Kataria, Pietro Bonfà, Roberto De Renzi, Andrea Capa Salinas, Stephen D. Wilson, Marc-Henri Julien, Samuele Sanna, Vesna F. Mitrović
arxiv-2512-09256.description: Abstract The interplay between superconductivity and charge-density wave (CDW) order, and its evolution with carrier density, is central to the physics of many quantum materials, notably high- T c T_{c} cuprates and kagome metals. Hole-doped kagome compounds exhibit puzzling double-dome superconductivity and, as chemical substitution inevitably introduces quenched disorder, their properties remain poorly understood.

arxiv-2601-11438.title: Channel Estimation in MIMO Systems Aided by Microwave Linear Analog Computers (MiLACs) PubID: pubid:
arxiv-2601-11438.creator: Qiaosen Zhang, Matteo Nerini, Bruno Clerckx
arxiv-2601-11438.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Qiaosen Zhang, Matteo Nerini, Bruno Clerckx. Microwave linear analog computers (MiLACs) have recently emerged as a promising solution for future gigantic multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, enabling beamforming with greatly reduced hardware and computational cost. However, channel estimation for MiLAC-aided systems remains an open problem. Conventional least squares (LS) and minimum mean square error (MMSE) estimation rely on intensive digital computation, which undermines the benefits offered by MiLACs. In this letter, we propose efficient LS and MMSE channel estimation schemes for MiLAC-aided MIMO systems.

pmc-10506229.title: Lower limb muscle strength and balance in older adults with a distal radius fracture: a systematic review
pmc-10506229.creator: Colin Forde, Philippa JA Nicolson, Charlotte Vye, Jessica CH Pun, Warren Sheehan, Matthew L Costa, Sarah E Lamb, David J Keene
pmc-10506229.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundDistal radius fractures are common fractures in older adults and associated with increased risk of future functional decline and hip fracture. Whether lower limb muscle strength and balance are impaired in this patient population is uncertain.

pmc-10537188.title: A Specific Carbohydrate Diet Virtual Teaching Kitchen Curriculum Promotes Knowledge and Confidence in Caregivers of Pediatric Patients with Inflammatory Bowel Disease
pmc-10537188.creator: Nancy Rivera, Kaylie Nguyen, Venus Kalami, Feifei Qin, Maya B Mathur, Rebecca Blankenburg, Ann Ming Yeh, David Miles Eisenberg
pmc-10537188.description: Diet-based approaches such as the Specific Carbohydrate Diet (SCD) have proposed health benefits for patients with Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD). Despite its potential effectiveness, patients and caregivers identified barriers towards implementing the SCD, and a majority expressed interest in formal education surrounding the SCD.

pmc-10638706.title: Chromosome microarray analysis combined with karyotype analysis is a powerful tool for the detection in pregnant women with high-risk indicators
pmc-10638706.creator: Guanhua Qian, Liuyun Cai, Hong Yao, Xiaojing Dong
pmc-10638706.description: BackgroundKaryotype analysis and fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) are commonly used for prenatal diagnosis, however they have many disadvantages. Chromosome microarray analysis (CMA) has the potential to overcome these disadvantages. This study aimed to evaluate the clinical value of CMA in the diagnosis of fetal chromosomal anomalies in southwest of China.

pmc-12758882.creator: Venkatraman Indiran
pmc-12758882.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ound (a) and color Doppler (b) transverse section in a patient with true umbilical cord knot showing a segment of the umbilical cord (black arrows) surrounded by another loop of umbilical cord (white arrows), representing the hanging noose sign.

pmc-13251119.title: Percutaneous versus open release for trigger finger: a retrospective comparison of outcomes, complications, and costs in 110 patients from a Swedish cohort
pmc-13251119.creator: Cecilia Stalberg Ostwald, Anders Henricson, Daniel Muder
pmc-13251119.description: BackgroundTrigger finger (TF) is a common hand condition often requiring surgery. Open surgery (OS) is the standard treatment, with high success rates. Percutaneous release (PR) offers potential advantages regarding cost, procedure time, and recovery, although its effectiveness remains debated in different clinical settings.

pmc-13310861.title: Prolactin-Releasing Hormone Receptor (PRLHR) enhances radiosensitivity and exacerbates DNA damage in glioblastoma post-irradiation by inhibiting Y-box-binding protein-1 (YBX1) nuclear translocation: a novel perspective on precision radiotherapy
pmc-13310861.creator: Yuning Qiu, Jing Zhang, Jingdian Liu, Zilong Wang, Zeyu Ma, Minkai Wang, Qimeng Wang, Xianzhi Liu, Dongming Yan, Zhenyu Zhang
pmc-13310861.description: Radiotherapy is a cornerstone for glioblastoma multiforme (GBM), yet its efficacy is severely hampered by intrinsic radioresistance, the molecular basis of which remains elusive, and overcoming this resistance poses a persistent challenge for GBM therapeutics. This study aims to identify novel key regulators of radiosensitivity in glioblastoma (GBM), with the goal of developing potent radiosensitizers.

pmc-13433452.title: Severe non-atopic prurigo nodularis in an otherwise healthy elderly patient: rapid multidimensional response to dupilumab
pmc-13433452.creator: Alessandra Ventre, Federica Nuccio, Sebastiano Gangemi, Luisa Ricciardi
pmc-13433452.description: BackgroundPrurigo nodularis (PN) is a chronic neuroimmune skin disorder characterized by intensely pruritic nodules, severe impairment of quality of life and significant psychosocial burden. Prior to the approval of targeted therapies, management relied on conventional agents with limited efficacy. Recent evidence of its neuroimmune pathogenesis have led to the approvement of targeted biologics.
